Metrics.slo_burn_rate: Error-budget burn rate of a service's SLO; above 1 the budget is spent faster than it accrues.
Metrics.redis_connections: Open connections to the shared Redis, grouped by the client service that opened them.
Metrics.latency_p95: 95th-percentile request duration in seconds, per service.
Metrics.dependency_wait_p95: 95th-percentile time in seconds a service waits on its dependency per attempt.
Metrics.error_ratio: Share of a service's requests that fail.
Metrics.retry_rate: Retries per second a service makes to its dependency.
Metrics.redis_errors: Redis errors per second a service hits.
